objects.description:
[NIMBUS MANTICORE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1059) has reset passwords of valid accounts to include domain accounts in order to obtain persistence and escalate privileges.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549TTPsTools_Nov2025)     

[NIMBUS MANTICORE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1059) has reset passwords for domain controller accounts using `net.exe` through the command `net user DC-01$ P@ssw0rd`.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549TTPsTools_Nov2025)    

[NIMBUS MANTICORE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1059) has also abused Resource-Based Constrained Delegation (RBCD) assignments to impersonate high-privileged users and gain unauthorized access to services and resources.(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549TTPsTools_Nov2025)
